parameters.name: ReceivedMessages
parameters.description: The number of XMPP stanzas (iq, presence, or message) that have been received on this {{object|##.Connection}}.

parameters.name: TransmittedMessages
parameters.description: The number of XMPP stanzas (iq, presence, or message) that have been transmitted by this {{object|##.Connection}}.

parameters.name: ReceivedErrorMessages
parameters.description: The number of XMPP stanzas (iq, presence, or message) that have been received on this {{object|##.Connection}} where the type attribute had a value of "error".

parameters.name: TransmittedErrorMessages
parameters.description: The number of XMPP stanzas (iq, presence, or message) that have been transmitted by this {{object|##.Connection}} where the type attribute had a value of "error".

object.description: XMPP Connection statistics information for this resource.
